entries.source: Drag to position the cursor. Tap the on-screen drawing button, then drag to move the cursor and draw. Tap it again to stop. Choose the brush and stroke settings under Draw → Drawing.
entries.wording: Håla para un pega i cursor gi lugåt-ña. Patcha i buton para dibuhu gi pantalla, pues håla para un muebi i cursor ya dibuhu. Patcha ta'lo para un påra. Atyik i pinsel yan i inatyik para i råya siha gi tab «Dibuhu», gi gurupun ramienta «Dibuhu».

entries.source: New lines start new columns. Sideways words preserve joining scripts, including Mongolian. Upright characters keep combining marks and emoji sequences together.
entries.wording: I nuebu na råyan tinige' ha tutuhun un nuebu na kolumna. Yanggin i palåbra siha manbira, ti masipåra i lettra siha ni ma'eskribi mandanña', kumu gi Mongolian. Yanggin tunas i simbulu siha, ti masipåra i marka ginin i simbulu-ña ni ha tulaika, yan ti masipåra i emoji siha ni manadanña'.

entries.source: Estimates include the current canvas and clipboard, sampled decoding and editing buffers. Actual memory use varies. A smaller copy loses detail. Imports use the selected opaque background; the original file stays unchanged.
entries.wording: Gi katkulasion, ineluk i RAM para i brin ni un usa på'gu, i kopia ni mapo'lu para u mapega (clipboard), yan i tempuråriu na kåmpu para u mababa i pinenta gi mås dikiki' na mineddung yan para u matulaika. Ti todu i tiempu parehu i RAM ni ma'usa. Malingu palu na detalye gi mås dikiki' na kopia. Ma'usa i kulot ni ma'atyik para i brin sin transparensia an mana'hålum i pinenta. Ti matulaika i urihinåt na dokumentu.

entries.source: Fits the current budget.
entries.wording: Nahung i RAM ni ma sedi på'gu.

entries.source: Image assembly workspace. Drag placed images or drop thumbnails to snap at right or bottom targets. Pinch to zoom; drag empty space to pan.
entries.wording: Kåmpun cho'chu' para i dinanña' i pinenta siha. Håla i pinenta ni mapega pat libera un dikiki' na mostra gi oriyan akat pat gi oriyan papa' para u mapega. Na'hihot pat na'chågu' i dos na kålulot para un tulaika i zoom; håla gi lugåt ni tåya' pinenta para un muebi i mostra.

entries.source: Set the top-left corner of this image on the output canvas. X and Y are whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their current positions. Overlap is allowed here; images imported later are drawn on top. The canvas expands to include all placed images. Crops and sizes stay unchanged.
entries.wording: Atyik i lugåt i eskina sanhilo' gi akagui' para esti na pinenta gi brin ni para u mahuyong. Intiru na pixels i X yan Y, disdi seru. Ti mamomuyi i ottru na pinenta siha. Siña un na'danña' i pinenta siha na un matampe i ottru. I pinenta ni mana'hålum dispues mamostra gi sanhilo'. Dumångkulu i brin para u fanahung todu i pinenta ni mapega. Ti matulaika i inatyik i påtti siha ni i mineddung.
